//: Kit GENERATES `.svelte-kit/tsconfig.json`, and this file adds to it.
`verbatimModuleSyntax` is Kit's default and it is turned off here, which is the one
setting worth explaining. This repository consumes its packages from SOURCE — a
workspace link points at `core/src`, not at a built `.d.ts` — so a stricter setting
in an APPLICATION is applied to the framework's files rather than to this
application's, and reports forty errors in code this package does not own. A
consumer installing the published tarball never meets it, because a tarball ships
declarations and declarations have no import style left to check.
`paths` is deliberately absent: Kit warns that a hand-written one fights the
generated one, so `@lanka_di` is declared as `kit.alias` in svelte.config.js and Kit
writes it into both the build and the types.
